The library has 65429 volumes with 13,170 titles of books and about 3550 back volumes of scientific and technical periodicals. The library also subscribes to nearly 79 National print journals and 25 magazines and more than 6692 e-journals & 10403 e- books. A separate reference section is maintained with Handbooks and General knowledge books. Interlibrary loan facility is available through DELNET. Central Library supports departmental libraries in all departments. The library follows open access system encouraging the user to browse freely in the stock area.
LIBRARY @ A GLANCE
Huge Library complex with an area of 21,792 sft. (Ground , I, & II floors)
The ground floor accommodates Book Circulation Section, Newspapers, Magazines and Reprography / Photocopy
The first floor hosts Back volumes, Project reports, P.G. books, Digital Library and books for competitive examinations etc.
The second floor accommodates current Journals and Reference books
Equipped with modern infrastructure, with a reading capacity for 500 users.
Collection above 65429 volumes.
More than 6692+ Online E-Journals & 10403 E-books
More than 104 Print Journals & Magazines
Automated Library powered by ERP Software
A Team of 08 professionally qualified and trained staff, aided by 5 support staff.
WORKING HOURS
Regular working hours --> 08 : 00 AM to 08 : 00 PM
Circulation hours --> 09 : 00 AM to 06 : 00 PM
Book Return hours --> 09 : 00 AM to 06 : 00 PM
Book Issue hours --> 09 : 00 AM to 06 : 00 PM
Reference hours --> 08 : 00 AM to 08 : 00 PM
On 2 nd Saturdays --> 09 : 00 AM to 05 : 00 PM
On Sundays --> 09.00 AM to 1.00 PM
The above timings are subject to change from time to time.
It remains closed on all Holidays as notified in the gazette.
LIBRARY COMMITTEE
Functions of the Library Committee:
The library committee is intended to plan and coordinate the execution of the requisite procedures for the functioning of the library.
It takes up the processes of identifying, planning, and such other aspects of the procurement of and processing the books, journals, manuals etc.
It ensures the up gradation of the library to suit the ever-changing industrial requirements.
The committee is expected to monitor the allocation of funds for the books, journals, manuals etc. and the digital processing of information, including on-line journals.
